summary.en: An artefact and the check on it: two oblique boxes cut by a section line, notes off the cut, a dimension repeating the check, the output box, and an inspection stamp in the line colour.
summary.zh: 一个产物和对它的检查：两个斜投影方框被剖切线切开，剖面旁引出注释，尺寸线上重复检查结果，输出方框，再加一枚线条色的检验章。

fits: A sheet about what the product produces and how a machine verifies it: an archive, a build, a package.
notFor: Processes (use lap-loop); more than two parts; checks a person makes (use detail-confirm).

intent.en: Open the artefact like a section drawing so its insides are evidence, and certify it in the machine's colour.
intent.zh: 像剖面图那样切开产物，让内里成为证据，再用机器的颜色加以证明。

content.en: Label, title, sub, two parts (name, description, up to two lines), the cut label, 1–2 notes, a dimension (code), the output, a stamp.
content.zh: 标签、标题、副标题、两个部件（名称、说明、最多两行）、剖切标签、1–2 条注释、尺寸（代码）、输出、印章。

fits.zh: 讲产品产出什么、机器怎么验证的一张图：归档、构建、软件包。

notFor.zh: 流程（用 lap-loop）；超过两个部件；人做的检查（用 detail-confirm）。

en: The dimension is code (a hash): keep it Latin and ≤ 28 characters or it collides with the output box.
zh: 尺寸是代码（哈希），保持拉丁字符且 ≤ 28 个，否则会撞到输出方框。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
